name: SkaleAgents
description: Scans Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and Pulumi IaC plus CI files and Dockerfiles for misconfigurations and committed secrets, and reviews app architecture, from an MCP server or offline CLI.

skills.name: Scan IaC
skills.description: Scans Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible, Bicep, ARM and Dockerfiles, returning a resource inventory plus findings with rule IDs, severity and remediation.

skills.name: Review Architecture
skills.description: Reviews a single source snippet or infrastructure config for security, reliability and cost concerns, such as disabled timeouts or unbounded retry limits.

skills.name: Review Application Architecture
skills.description: Maps related source files into an import graph and checks Next.js boundaries, covering data access, authorization, reliability and delivery with cited evidence.

skills.name: Plan Architecture Review
skills.description: Starts a review consultation from a repository-relative file inventory and project goals, suggesting files to read and asking focused follow-up questions.

skills.name: Offline CLI Scan
skills.description: Scans IaC, CI, Dockerfile and package files locally with no account and no network calls, supporting baselines, changed-file mode and JSON output.
